name: GetFilesInFolderNode
label: Retrieve Files in Folder
description: Retrieves a list of files from a specified folder with optional filtering, subfolder inclusion, and multi-level sorting.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder path
fields.description: The absolute path of the folder to retrieve files from (e.g., 'C:\Documents\Reports').

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File filter
fields.description: One or more file patterns separated by semicolons (;). Examples: *.txt;*.pdf;*.docx;invoice_*.xlsx. Default: * (all files).

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include subfolders
fields.description: When true, includes files from all subdirectories recursively. Default: true.

fields.name: FailUponDeniedAccess
fields.label: Fail on access denied
fields.description: When true, the activity fails if access to any subfolder is denied. When false, inaccessible folders are skipped. Default: true.

fields.name: SortBy
fields.label: Sort by
fields.description: Primary sort criterion for the file list. Default: No sort.

selectOptions.label: No sort
selectOptions.description: No sorting applied; files returned in file-system order.

selectOptions.label: Full path
selectOptions.description: Sort by the complete file path.

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the parent directory path.

selectOptions.label: File name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name including extension.

selectOptions.label: Name without extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name excluding the extension.

selectOptions.label: Size
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file size in bytes.

fields.name: Descending
fields.label: Descending order
fields.description: When true, sorts files in descending order. Default: false (ascending).

fields.name: ThenBy
fields.label: Then sort by
fields.description: Secondary sort criterion applied after the primary sort. Default: No sort.

selectOptions.label: No sort
selectOptions.description: No sorting applied; files returned in file-system order.

selectOptions.label: Full path
selectOptions.description: Sort by the complete file path.

selectOptions.label: Directory
selectOptions.description: Sort by the parent directory path.

selectOptions.label: File name
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name including extension.

selectOptions.label: Name without extension
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file name excluding the extension.

selectOptions.label: Size
selectOptions.description: Sort by the file size in bytes.

fields.name: RetrievedFiles
fields.label: Retrieved files
fields.description: The list of full file paths that matched the filter and sort criteria.
